svg.text: GOVPH • REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES • NATIONAL DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENT COUNCIL
LIPA CITY DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENT OFFICE (LCDRRMO)
Life-Sustaining Emergency Supplies for Every Lipa Household During the First 72 Hours

g.text: 1. WATER & NUTRITION (MIN. 3-DAY SUPPLY)
• Drinking Water: 4 liters (1 gallon) per person per day for at least 3 days.
• Non-Perishable Food: Easy-open canned meats, tuna, beans, and high-calorie biscuits.
• Manual Can Opener: Rotary mechanical opener (do not rely on electric openers).
• Reusable Mess Kit: Plastic or stainless steel plate, spoon, fork, and thermal cup.
• Water Purification: Aquatabs or unscented bleach bottle with dropper.
Inspect food and water expiration dates every 6 months without fail.
2. FIRST AID & HYGIENE ESSENTIALS
• First Aid Kit: Sterile gauze, betadine, micropore tape, elastic bandages, burn gel.
• Personal Medications: 7-day reserve of prescription drugs (hypertension, diabetes, asthma).
• Emergency OTC Drugs: Paracetamol, oral rehydration salts (ORS), loperamide, antihistamines.
• Respiratory Masks: N95 or KN95 masks for volcanic ash/vog and dust exposure.
• Sanitation: 70% alcohol, bath soap, toothbrush/paste, wet wipes, heavy-duty garbage bags.
Store all sterile items and medications inside sealed waterproof zip pouches.
3. LIGHT, POWER & COMMUNICATIONS
• LED Flashlight: Heavy-duty waterproof flashlight with fresh spare alkaline batteries.
• Portable AM/FM Radio: Battery or hand-crank transistor radio for official updates.
• Power Bank: 20,000mAh external battery pack with phone charging cables.
• Rescue Whistle: Loud pea-less emergency whistle (blow 3 short blasts for help).
• Multi-Tool: Compact pocket knife, pliers, duct tape, and nylon rope (5 meters).
Never use open candles during earthquake or typhoon aftermath due to gas leaks.
4. VITAL DOCUMENTS, CASH & GEAR
• Waterproof Documents: Birth certificates, land titles, passports, insurance policies, medical records.
• Emergency Cash: Small denomination paper bills (₱20, ₱50, ₱100) and coins (ATMs will be down).
• Emergency Contacts: Laminated contact card with Lipa Rescue & relatives' numbers.
• Clothing & Protection: 1 full change of warm clothes, sturdy closed sneakers, rain poncho.
• Thermal Foil Blanket: Lightweight space blanket for shock and hypothermia prevention.
Store the Go Bag right beside the exit door for instantaneous retrieval.

svg.text: Directly sourced and accredited from the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC) and Lipa CDRRMO.
